title: The INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE privileges are in Beta
body:
The `INSERT`, `UPDATE`, and `DELETE` privileges are in [Beta](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types) in Unity Catalog. These privileges are least-privilege alternatives to `MODIFY` that let you grant write access to a table's data without also granting the ability to change its schema or other metadata.

The privileges require [Databricks Runtime](/aws/en/release-notes/runtime) 18.1 or above.

For details, see [Fine-grained DML privileges](/aws/en/data-governance/unity-catalog/access-control/fine-grained-dml-privileges).
